t: A smart camera with a touchscreen that recognizes faces, objects and gestures.
steps: Buy HuskyLens 2 from DFRobot or a maker store such as Stemfinity.
Get a host board such as a micro:bit, Arduino or UNIHIKER.
Connect the camera to the host board with the Gravity cable.
Power up and choose Face Recognition on the touchscreen.
Point the camera at a face and press the button to teach it.
Open MakeCode or Mind+ and add the HuskyLens 2 extension.
Try the face recognition example and show the face number on the host board.
Explore other skills such as line tracking or object classification.
meta: Open Code. From $89.90. A few stores.
